fields.description: Program Description 1. Program Introduction Editor Notes: The stomatology in DMU had been set up for 8 years and taught by experienced teachers. The BDS program in English medium started in 2009. The duration of the program is 5 years including 1 year internship. All teaching faculty are local teachers with rich experience and abroad study or teaching experience. 2. Teaching Objective Editor Notes: The BDS program aims to decelop studnets with professional skills and knowledge. To cultivate senior applied Stomatology talents with strong hands-on skills, entrepreneurial ability, and strong ability to develop. To cultivate Doctors for diagnosis and treatment of stomatological disease. 3. Main subjects & courses Editor Notes: There are 19 main courses for Stomotology. Biochemistry Physiology Medical Immunology Medical Microbiology Experiment of medical functional science Pathology Pharmacology Clinical Diagnostics Oral Anatomical Physiology Oral Histology and Pathology Internal Medicine Cariology And Endodontics Periodontics, Oral and Maxillofacial Surgery Prosthodontics Orthodontics Prevention of Oral Medicine Oral Mucosal Disease Study Surgery 4. Courses Arrangement Editor Notes: The following is the courses arrangement for its 10 terms. 1st semester to 6th semester: course for basic medicine Mathematics, Physical Education, Human Anatomy/Chinese Language, Medical Chemistry, Medical Physics, Physical Education, Chinese Culture/Computer, Histology & Embryology, Cell Biology, Biochemistry/Physiology, Microbiology, Immunology, Parasitology, Medical Statistics/Pathology, Pathophysiology, Pharmacology, Hygiene, Epidemiology/Otolaryngology, Clinical Diagnostics, Diagnostics, Medical Imageology, Surgery, Oral Anatomy and Physiology, Oral Histology and Pathology 7th semester to 8th semester: course for clinical medicine Internal Medicine, Oral Medicine, Oral and Maxillofacial Surgery, Prosthodontics, Orthodontic, Oral Material, Medical Ethics, Medical Chinese Language/Clinical Psychology, Oral Radiology, Public-health Dentistry, Pediatric Dentistry 9th semester to 10th semester: internship Oral Internal Medicine, Oral Surgery and Oral Rehabilitation 5. Knowledge and Ability to Master Editor Notes: Graduates are going to have a good command of the basic theoretical knowledge as well as its professional stomatological knowledge. Basic theoretical knowledge and experimental skills of preclinical medicine and clinical medicine; Basic theoretical knowledge and clinical operational skills of various disciplines of Stomatology; Dentistry common disease diagnosis, treatment and initial processing of urgent, difficult, severe symptom; A basic knowledge of dental work and general skills; Mastering medical literature search, the basic method of data survey, with initial capacity of oral medical research. 6. Internship and Employment Editor Notes: Graduates are mainly recruited by hospitals & universities. A total of 3,541 graduates of our school graduate in 2012, of which a total of 42 graduates of doctoral students, graduate students were 883 (including 27 foreign students, Hong Kong, Macao and Taiwan regions student; A total of 191 seven-year Accelerated Degree Graduation students, 2425 of undergraduate and the specialist graduates; More than 90 graduates from the Stomatology employed by hospitals in different provinces; Sixty four freshmen are recruited each year by the university; In recent years, 18 research projects in the school have been funded from state, provincial and municipal sources. 7. Brief Introduction to Dalian Medical University Editor Notes: One of the most famous medical universities for English taught MBBS program. Founded in 1947 as Guandong Medical College, Dalian Medical University ( DLMEDU ) has developed into a multi-disciplinary medical university, famous for its MBBS Programs , located in the coastal city-Dalian. As the biggest harbor city in Northeast China region, Dalian is an important international shipping center, logistics center and financial center in Northeast Asia. Owning excellent environment and temperate climate, Dalian was firstly listed as the “Best Tourist Cities” of China. In 2009, it was recognized by UNEP and awarded the highest prize of international garden city by IFPRA. Learn Mor e>> 8. About the College of Stomatology Editor Notes: Graduates are mainly recruited by hospitals & universities. The College and Hospital of Stomatology, Dalian Medical University is a key teaching base and specialized hospital engaging in teaching, research and medical treatment, which is directly administrated by Department of Education of Liaoning Province; The College of Stomatology aims to foster high-rank talents in the field of dentistry with all-round development and proficiency in practical skills and to popularize and improve the level of prevention and treament for odontopathy and oral-maxillofacial disease; The College of Stomatology includes two secondary subjects, dental basic science and clinical science, with dental basic science as the key discipline of Liaoning Province; The College of Stomatology has established cooperative relationships with Tokyo Medical and Dental University, Showa University, Okayama University and Chonnam National University, respectively; Dentistry in Dalian Medical University is the model major in Liaoning province, which was established in 1960 and is now a provincial-level key discipline; The college has master's degree awarded in both dental basic and clinical science with most of its outstanding staffs getting their degree overseas; The college owns first-rate teaching instrument, like dental teaching access system and simulation mould and 3 large-scale multimedia laboratories have been built; Recently, 40% of. undergraduates are enrolled as graduate students, and employment rate reaches 100%. 9. Colorful Life Editor Notes: Every year, DLMEDU will hold many activities for international students. Graduation & Degree Awarding Ceremony Volleyball Tournament

fields.materials: Application Materials " * " means necessary documents that you must provide in your application. If you want to book our translation service , please pay and book it at least 2 weeks before the application deadline for submission of all documents; If you want to book our guardian service , you need to pay and book it 2 months before the application deadline, just in case your application fails because of failed to submit application documents on time. * 1. Certification of no criminal record * 2. English proficiency test certificate For example, IELTS or TOEFL, only for applicant whose native language is not English. * 3. Financial support statement Photocopy of the financial support statement with signature * 4. Physical Examination Form(only valid for 6 months) Please take it to hospital to have a checkup with all items, including personal information, photo, checking date, doctors' suggestion and signature. 5. For In-country and Extension Students Passport main page (new and old passports), visa page (please ensure continuity) Proof of current enrollment Transcript for the current academic period Explanation of extension circumstances 6. For In-country Transfer Students Passport main page (new and old passports), visa page (please ensure continuity) Transfer certificate/No objection certificate Verification statement Transcript from the previous school Admission letter (in Chinese and English) 7. Other materials If you are underage (over 17 years old, but not reach 18 when school starts), you should submit the Guardian letter which should be attested by the Chinese embassy in your country. * 8. Passport first page, visa page (please ensure continuity). * 9. Passport-Size photo * 10. Notarized highest degree transcripts, and then get the notarized copy certified by local Chinese embassy or consulate. 1.Transcripts that are not in Chinese or English must be translated into Chinese and then notarized. 2.After notarization, they must also be authenticated by the local Chinese embassy or consulate (for countries that are part of the Hague Convention, an Apostille is required). 3.You must bring the original transcripts, as well as the original notarization and authentication documents, when reporting for registration. Otherwise, you will not be able to complete the registration. * 11. Notarized highest degree graduation certificate, documents in languages other than Chinese or English need to be translated into Chinese during notarization, and then get the notarized copy certified For students from countries joined Hague Conventions could provide apostille documents. Documents in languages other than Chinese or English need to be translated into Chinese during notarization, and make sure you bring all original application documents including these to China during registration. * 12. CSCA Test Transcript(s) -You need to take the official CSCA test organized by the Chinese government and submit the corresponding subject result transcript(s) when applying. Learn more about the CSCA test >> -The test covers Chinese (Humanities and STEM Chinese), Mathematics, Physics, and Chemistry. Mathematics is required for all programs, while other subjects depend on the university’s specific requirements. -We are updating detailed information for each university, including the required subjects you have to take for each program and their score requirements. Once the updates are ready, you can check the attachment and information here for this university for the latest information. If no attachment is available yet, it usually means the university has not announced further details. -Mathematics and Chemistry test results are required. Tips: For applicants who are in China: If you are an employee, you still need to provide employment separation certificate and your current residence permit. If you are a student, you need to provide transfer certificate, leaving certificate, certificate of attendance rate issued by previous school and your current residence permit.
